uncertain.api_breadth: About 11 live operations: notebooks create/get/listRecentlyViewed/batchDelete/share, sources batchCreate/uploadFile/get/batchDelete, audioOverviews create/delete (podcast API deprecated; DiscoverSources/Label services listed with no RPCs shown). No query/chat endpoint. Borderline narrow vs moderate; labeled moderate by the 10-50 count rule.
uncertain.access: Docs licensing page says 14-day free trial; marketing page says 30-day trial. Either way ongoing API use needs a paid license (US$9/license/month, minimum 15). Consumer NotebookLM (notebooklm.google.com) has no public API.
uncertain.mcp: Google's Supported products list for Google Cloud remote MCP servers has no NotebookLM entry; the discoveryengine MCP server only exposes search, conversational_search, list_engines. All NotebookLM MCP servers found (PyPI notebooklm-mcp-server, PleasePrompto/notebooklm-mcp, jacob-bd/notebooklm-mcp-cli) are third-party.
uncertain.api_styles: REST documented; an RPC/proto reference (google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha) is published, implying gRPC, but gRPC usage was not tested.

notes: Product appears renamed in docs to 'Gemini Notebook Enterprise'. API is v1alpha / Preview, user-credential only (gcloud user token), regional endpoints like us-discoveryengine.googleapis.com. For a multi-user toolkit, Google OAuth with the cloud-platform scope would likely need Google OAuth app verification (not confirmed here).

notes.access: rubric consistency (same as Snowflake): A free trial of NotebookLM Enterprise licenses gives working API access, then a paid license. Labelled like Snowflake's 30-day trial. The pipeline was right. (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/notebooklm-enterprise/docs/set-up-licensing)
